approved_decision.rule: Adopt HNK_PHONOTACTIC_PROFILE_V2 as the current governed phonotactic/authoring profile, explicitly separating corpus facts, B1-B5 governed phonological rules and optional authoring preferences.
approved_decision.v1_effect: HNK_PHONOTACTIC_PROFILE_V1 becomes HISTORICAL_PRIOR and remains preserved for provenance.

governance_decisions.decision: Do not create mandatory CV alternation or ban initial vowels/internal clusters; evaluate non-CV shapes case-by-case.
Do not restore the old avoid-hiatus preference; adjacent vowels are legitimate under B2/B3.
Retain TS/G30 atomic treatment, final-consonant compatibility, bridge separation and collision checking as compatible profile principles.
Do not assign word-specific stress or any unresolved romanization unit in B6.
B6 changes no semantics, morphology, grammar, productivity or curriculum slots.
